sdk_selection.meaning: public SDK selection; publication is not installed-host or all-platform shipping qualification

methods_selection.meaning: exact selected public source and ABI; source identity alone does not attest a packaged binary

notes: Rust owner publication is recorded in the Root release-integration-20261109 receipts; this declaration is not a Studio build or installed-runtime qualification.

Use the ordinary crates.io graph without local source overrides. Core 0.5.1 and Studio resolve one Rust IO version (0.3.6) through minor-level requirements; browser npm/source artifacts are separate profiles.

packaged_methods_identity selects only the source-built public v1.3.19 profile. It does not attribute a PyPI wheel library to that commit/tree. Packaged selection still requires the matching contract, binary size/SHA-256, exact ABI and Core preflight.

Packaged startup also accepts the exact Linux x64 public wheel artifact declared in scripts/methods-public-wheel-profile.json, with unknown source; it is disjoint from packaged_methods_identity. The separate local native eccbe5 artifact must not be relabelled.

SDK 1.4.19 is public on PyPI; build/runtime-cohort.json records its wheel SHA-256 and source commit. sdk_selection.publication_status records registry availability only; each installed host requires its own bake and packaged admission. Historical shipping attestations do not qualify this profile.
The historical published-registry cohort remains byte-exact in studio_native_source_cohort_v1.json.
